title: Python async HTTP client — use httpx.AsyncClient
description: Use httpx.AsyncClient with async context manager for async HTTP requests in Python.
problem_statement: Need to make async HTTP requests in Python for LLM API calls.

operations.content:
import httpx
from typing import Any

async def fetch_json(url: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as client:
        resp = await client.get(url)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()
